title: Portuguese Bread Gratina
description: A rich and satisfying gratin made with portuguese bread and a creamy emulsified sauce.
instructions: Arrange half of the bread cubes in the prepared baking dish.
Pour half of the emulsified sauce over the bread cubes.
Sprinkle with half of the grated cheese and half of the chopped eggs.
Repeat the layers, starting with the bread, then the emulsified sauce, the remaining cheese, and finally the remaining eggs.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is set.
Let the gratin rest for 5 minutes before serving.
